name: City of Chicago - Digital Accessibility (DoIT / Chicago Design System)
standard: WCAG 2.0 AA (stated target; Title II requires 2.1 AA by 2027-04-26)
applies_to: City of Chicago websites and digital products.
requires: WCAG 2.0 AA per the Design System statement; DoIT publishes a digital accessibility guide for app and web content creators
mobile: not addressed on the page reviewed.
enforcement: Federal Title II; Illinois Information Technology Accessibility Act binds state agencies, not the City (unverified).
notes: The chicago.gov DoIT page returned 403; its content (WCAG 2.0 AA, DoIT working with departments) is from search snippets. The City's stated WCAG 2.0 target lags the federal 2.1 AA requirement - a gap worth flagging to anyone scoping Chicago work.
